name: Cauliflower Salad with Bacon, Blue Cheese, Walnuts, Grapes & Arugula
instructions: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into bite-sized pieces.

Once the water comes to a boil, add cauliflower and salt; stir for a few seconds. Return to a boil and cook, uncovered, until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold, running water. Set aside.

While the cauliflower is cooking, transfer walnuts to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, stirring halfway through, until lightly toasted, 4-6 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, sugar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
When the cauliflower is done, wipe the pot clean with paper towels, then set aside for later use.

Return the pot to medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 4-5 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
Meanwhile, halve grapes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim celery and green onions; slice crosswise into thin pieces and add both to the bowl.
Mince half of the walnuts and add to the bowl. Roughly chop remaining walnuts and set aside for serving.
Add cauliflower and arugula to the bowl; toss to combine the cauliflower salad.
To serve, divide cauliflower salad between plates or bowls; top with blue cheese, bacon, and remaining walnuts. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
